gold.title: SQL injection vulnerability: the `username` request parameter is concatenated directly into the SQL query string on line
gold.description: SQL injection vulnerability: the `username` request parameter is concatenated directly into the SQL query string on line 40 without sanitization or parameterization. An attacker can inject arbitrary SQL (e.g., `' OR '1'='1' --`) to dump or modify data. Use a PreparedStatement with parameterized queries instead.

candidate.title: SQL injection: request parameter concatenated into the query string
candidate.description: username parameter from request.getParameter is spliced into Statement query with no escaping. Allows injection attacks like ?username=%25' UNION SELECT to break out of LIKE literal and dump arbitrary table contents.

promotion_candidates.title: Database credentials hardcoded in source
promotion_candidates.description: app_user and app_pass are literal strings compiled into artifact and committed to git. Production DB credentials exposed to anyone with repo access or built WAR; rotation requires code change and redeploy.

promotion_candidates.title: Admin endpoint performs no authorization check
promotion_candidates.description: Servlet at /api/admin/users/search returns user IDs and emails but never checks session, role, or token. Any unauthenticated caller can enumerate full user table.
